name: What is the typical process for replacing existing siding with fiber cement?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for replacing existing siding with fiber cement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process begins with an initial consultation and estimate from City Dweller, LLC. Once approved, the existing siding is carefully removed and disposed of. The exterior sheathing is then inspected for any damage or needed repairs. A weather-resistant barrier is installed, followed by the precise cutting and installation of the new fiber cement siding panels. Trim, caulking, and painting (if unprimed) complete the project, ensuring a watertight and aesthetically pleasing finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes consultation, old siding removal, sheathing inspection, weather barrier installation, new siding placement, trim, and finishing.
